certification.name: Google Cloud Red Team Specialist
certification.description: Red team certification for Google Cloud covering abuse of cloud services and adversary techniques mapped to MITRE ATT&CK Cloud. Earned by submitting at least 15 flags in a 30-day practical challenge lab.
certification.currency_note: Includes course material and a 30-day challenge lab; lower promotional prices are frequent; the issuer writes the acronym both as GCRTS and CGRTS
